title: Arthur742Ramos/KuroshSubgroupTheorem
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
summary: Formalizes the sharp Schreier index formula for finite-index subgroups of free groups and the Kurosh subgroup theorem for arbitrary subgroups of indexed free products. The Schreier proof realizes a subgroup as the vertex group of a finite action-groupoid covering, while the Kurosh proof constructs the Bass--Serre tree, a locally bijective graph-of-groups cover, and its path-lifting normal form. review.reason: Lean formalization of the Schreier index formula and Kurosh subgroup theorem.
